001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.log4j;
002
003import org.apache.logging.log4j.spi.Provider;
004
005import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
006
007/**
008 * Registered via {@link java.util.ServiceLoader} ({@code META-INF/services/}
009 * {@link Provider org.apache.logging.log4j.spi.Provider}), not the older
010 * {@code META-INF/log4j-provider.properties} mechanism: decompiling this version of
011 * {@code log4j-api} shows that path's {@code Provider(Properties, URL, ClassLoader)}
012 * constructor unconditionally sets {@code versions} to <code>null</code>, which
013 * {@code ProviderUtil}/{@code validVersion} then rejects outright ("Ignoring provider for
014 * incompatible version"), confirmed empirically: a properties-file-registered provider is
015 * silently never selected. The subclass-plus-{@link java.util.ServiceLoader} path used
016 * here still populates {@link #getVersions()} correctly (from the
017 * {@link Provider#Provider(Integer, String, Class) Provider(Integer, String, Class)}
018 * constructor called below), so it is picked up correctly.
019 */
020@ServiceProvider(Provider.class)
021public final class RainbowGumLog4jProvider extends Provider {
022
023        /**
024         * For {@link java.util.ServiceLoader}.
025         */
026        public RainbowGumLog4jProvider() {
027                super(10, CURRENT_VERSION, RainbowGumLoggerContextFactory.class);
028        }
029
030}
